purpose: PJM 2026 Load Forecast Report extracts for the Dominion (DOM) zone: monthly peak and energy forecast plus the annual peak series, used as the MW scale reference for the North-Virginia data-centre case study.

sources.pjm_2026_load_report_docs: data/raw/pjm_load_forecast_2026/v2026/upstream/dominion-documentation.pdf (Dominion letter to the PJM Load Analysis Team, 6 Jan 2026)

quotes: ELOAs are not considered firm load. The sum of the capacity values of all ELOAs is considered as potential long-term growth.
The sum of the capacity values of all ESAs is considered as near-term growth potential that supports the forecast.
as of July 2025, the capacity value of these contracts is 47 GW (9.8 ESA + 7.1 CLOA + 30.1 ELOA). The Company is forecasting 16.6 GW of demand by 2046, not the 47 GW of capacity.

conventions.peak_mw: zone summer peak from the report data workbook, MW

caveats: The 47 GW contract figure is capacity under contract, not demand; Dominion itself forecasts 16.6 GW of data-centre demand by 2046. Do not report 47 GW (or an 'ELOA' subset) as connected load.
DOM zone peak includes all Dominion load, not only data centres.
The monthly series is PJM's forecast, not observed load.
